title: Bellwether
pitch: You are the lead sheep: your flock is your health, ammo and army all at once.
howto: Graze grass patches to birth lambs and grow the flock. Wolves hunt your sheep and drag them to the fence - spend sheep on Ram shots, Stampedes and Wool Walls to stop them. Survive to dusk to bank the flock and shear wool for permanent upgrades and new breeds.
controls: Hold and drag to lead the flock. Tap the three big buttons to spend sheep on spells. WASD + 1/2/3 on desktop.
